digest.component_or_area: MCP client credential delivery and preflight validation
key_entities: omitting MCP server without an exact ready client
propositions: Codex omits the Rebar MCP server at startup when the configured bearer_token_env_var names a variable absent from the process environment.
The documented setup prescribes a transient shell export that does not persist across shell sessions, leaving the credential unavailable to subsequent Codex invocations.
Local config at ~/.codex/config.toml names REBAR_CODEX_PAT, which does not appear anywhere in the repository canonical setup; even a correctly persisted MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CODEX would not be read.
The startup diagnostic 'omitting MCP server without an exact ready client' does not identify the missing variable name or the supported remediation path.
No durable, secret-safe credential-delivery mechanism or preflight validation currently exists for GUI-launched or terminal-launched Codex processes.
